ghi_chu: Lô kể chuyện 23/10/2026 — anh duyệt ~$6–8 ("vậy làm các camp kể chuyện mới đi"): kể chuyện chỉ thắng ở Number One (+300% tháng, 11 phim khác lỗ) → chỉ làm cho 5 phim ĐANG LÃI chưa có bản kể chuyện. Khuôn = bản thắng Number One: kể ngôi thứ nhất, 6 cảnh chữ ngắn, hook ngay câu đầu, thẻ cuối poster. Chữ tránh từ cấm cổng thoại (dead/kill…), CTA thẻ cuối theo luật AFS (không Tap/mũi tên). Step Back (EN) và ¡Atrás! (ES) cùng một truyện Vince Astor. — BẢN B: sửa theo người xem studio (6/10): thêm câu nối nhân quả, chữ cụ thể, mỗi cảnh 4s.

phim.ten: Step Back! That Homeless Man Is Not to be Messed with
phim.nhan_vat: VINCE = rugged man late 30s, long messy brown hair, full beard, worn dark coat (narrator, poster hero holding a gold signet ring); HELEN = elegant blonde CEO in a white dress; PHILIP = smug young man in a navy suit; HELEN'S MOTHER = woman 50s, dark bob, navy dress, pearls; BANK PRESIDENT = silver-haired man in a grey three-piece suit

boi_canh.mo_ta: Rainy city alley camp with barrel fires at night; sunlit Mediterranean-style mansion garden with fountain

canh.loi: I lived as a homeless man for three years. On purpose.
canh.anh: Night alley camp in the rain, barrel fire glowing. VINCE in his worn coat sits on a crate, beard wet, calm sharp eyes.
canh.dong: Rain falls, fire flickers on VINCE's face, slow push-in to his eyes.

canh.loi: It was a secret test. I passed. Now I'm America's Godfather, worth $20.9 billion.
canh.anh: Candlelit oak study. Old men in black suits bow as one places a gold signet ring in VINCE's rough palm.
canh.dong: The ring is set in his palm, VINCE closes his fist, camera rises behind the bowing men.

canh.loi: Years ago I saved a CEO's life. Today she proposed to me, rags and all.
canh.anh: Busy city sidewalk at dusk. HELEN in a white dress holds VINCE's dirty hands, passersby stare.
canh.dong: HELEN steps closer and takes his hands, crowd murmurs, handheld camera circles them.

canh.loi: Her mother mocked my rags. Her rich fiancé laughed in my face.
canh.anh: Mansion garden by a fountain. HELEN'S MOTHER sneers at VINCE while PHILIP in a navy suit smirks, arm around HELEN.
canh.dong: The mother points at VINCE's coat and laughs, PHILIP pulls HELEN away, slow pan.

canh.loi: They had no idea who I really was. So I stayed quiet.
canh.anh: Same garden. VINCE stands still, hands in coat pockets, a faint smile, while the family turns their backs.
canh.dong: Family walks off laughing, VINCE stays perfectly still, slow push-in on his half smile.

canh.loi: Tomorrow, the bank their family depends on will bow to me.
canh.anh: Grand marble hall. The silver-haired BANK PRESIDENT kneels before VINCE; HELEN'S MOTHER and PHILIP freeze in shock behind.
canh.dong: The banker drops to one knee, shocked faces behind, camera rises over VINCE's shoulder.

phim.ten: ¡Atrás! No te metas con ese vagabundo
phim.nhan_vat: VINCE = rugged man late 30s, long messy brown hair, full beard, worn dark coat (narrator, poster hero holding a gold signet ring); HELEN = elegant blonde CEO in a white dress; PHILIP = smug young man in a navy suit; HELEN'S MOTHER = woman 50s, dark bob, navy dress, pearls; BANK PRESIDENT = silver-haired man in a grey three-piece suit

boi_canh.mo_ta: Rainy city alley camp with barrel fires at night; sunlit Mediterranean-style mansion garden with fountain

canh.loi: Viví tres años como vagabundo. A propósito.
canh.anh: Night alley camp in the rain, barrel fire glowing. VINCE in his worn coat sits on a crate, beard wet, calm sharp eyes.
canh.dong: Rain falls, fire flickers on VINCE's face, slow push-in to his eyes.

canh.loi: Era una prueba secreta. La pasé. Ahora soy el Padrino de América: 20 900 millones.
canh.anh: Candlelit oak study. Old men in black suits bow as one places a gold signet ring in VINCE's rough palm.
canh.dong: The ring is set in his palm, VINCE closes his fist, camera rises behind the bowing men.

canh.loi: Hace años le salvé la vida a una CEO. Hoy me pidió matrimonio, con harapos y todo.
canh.anh: Busy city sidewalk at dusk. HELEN in a white dress holds VINCE's dirty hands, passersby stare.
canh.dong: HELEN steps closer and takes his hands, crowd murmurs, handheld camera circles them.

canh.loi: Su madre se burló de mis harapos. Su prometido rico se rio en mi cara.
canh.anh: Mansion garden by a fountain. HELEN'S MOTHER sneers at VINCE while PHILIP in a navy suit smirks, arm around HELEN.
canh.dong: The mother points at VINCE's coat and laughs, PHILIP pulls HELEN away, slow pan.

canh.loi: No tenían idea de quién era yo. Así que me quedé callado.
canh.anh: Same garden. VINCE stands still, hands in coat pockets, a faint smile, while the family turns their backs.
canh.dong: Family walks off laughing, VINCE stays perfectly still, slow push-in on his half smile.

canh.loi: Mañana, el banco del que depende su familia se inclinará ante mí.
canh.anh: Grand marble hall. The silver-haired BANK PRESIDENT kneels before VINCE; HELEN'S MOTHER and PHILIP freeze in shock behind.
canh.dong: The banker drops to one knee, shocked faces behind, camera rises over VINCE's shoulder.

phim.nhan_vat: ETHAN = young man mid 20s, dark tousled hair, black bomber jacket over grey tee, clean face with no wounds (narrator, poster hero); CLAIRE = his assistant, platinum blonde, champagne satin robe; CLAIRE'S MOTHER = woman 60s, red curly hair, leopard-print blouse, heavy jewelry; CLAIRE'S FATHER = heavyset man 60s in a navy suit

boi_canh.mo_ta: Modern luxury mansion with grand staircase, chandelier, wrought-iron front door; stormy evening light

canh.loi: I own a $17 million mansion.
canh.anh: Exterior of a modern luxury mansion at stormy dusk, ETHAN in a black jacket stands at the iron gate looking up at it.
canh.dong: Lightning flashes, ETHAN looks up at the house, slow push-in from behind.

canh.loi: My assistant's family moved in and locked me out of my own home.
canh.anh: Front doorway. CLAIRE in a satin robe blocks the door, her parents behind her smirking, ETHAN outside.
canh.dong: CLAIRE points to the side path, the door starts to close, push-in on ETHAN's calm face.

canh.loi: They made me kneel at a dog bowl. And livestreamed it.
canh.anh: Back porch. ETHAN kneels beside a metal dog bowl while CLAIRE'S MOTHER films him on a phone, laughing.
canh.dong: The mother raises the phone higher, ETHAN keeps his head down, slow orbit around him.

canh.loi: They called me the parasite. They said the house was theirs.
canh.anh: Grand living room with chandelier. CLAIRE'S FATHER lounges in a leather chair, CLAIRE'S MOTHER gestures at ETHAN dismissively.
canh.dong: The father waves him off, the mother laughs, camera pans from them to ETHAN standing still.

canh.loi: Then I found my signature forged on the deed.
canh.anh: Same room. ETHAN holds up the house deed showing a forged signature; CLAIRE's smile fades.
canh.dong: ETHAN lifts the deed, CLAIRE freezes, fast push-in on her face.

canh.loi: Tomorrow at 2 PM, the real owner walks back in.
canh.anh: Glass boardroom high above the city. An empty CEO chair at the head of the table, ETHAN's reflection in the window.
canh.dong: Camera glides toward the empty chair, ETHAN's reflection sharpens in the glass.

phim.ten: Dear Brother, Your Regret Came Too Late
phim.nhan_vat: STEPHANIE = 16-year-old girl, long wavy light-brown hair, burgundy school blazer, white shirt, striped tie (narrator, poster heroine); ALEXANDER = her older brother, 18, dark tousled hair, basketball tank top; MORRIS = their father, 50s, salt-and-pepper hair, dark suit; ABIGAIL = their cousin, 16, glossy dark hair, cream cardigan, sweet fake smile

boi_canh.mo_ta: Wealthy but cold family home: dark staircase, formal dining room, girl's small plain bedroom

canh.loi: My mom passed away the day I was born. My family blamed me.
canh.anh: Dim hallway with a framed portrait of a smiling woman. STEPHANIE in her school blazer stands alone looking at it.
canh.dong: Slow push-in from the portrait to STEPHANIE's teary eyes.

canh.loi: For sixteen years, my father never looked at me.
canh.anh: Formal dining room. MORRIS reads a newspaper at the head of the table while STEPHANIE sits at the far end, plate untouched.
canh.dong: MORRIS turns a page without looking up, camera tracks along the long empty table.

canh.loi: Only my brother Alexander still smiled at me.
canh.anh: Backyard hoop at sunset, ALEXANDER in a basketball tank passes STEPHANIE the ball, both smiling.
canh.dong: ALEXANDER tosses the ball, STEPHANIE catches it and laughs, warm handheld camera.

canh.loi: Then our cousin Abigail moved in, and everything changed.
canh.anh: Front door. ABIGAIL in a cream cardigan hugs ALEXANDER while STEPHANIE watches from the stairs, her smile gone.
canh.dong: ABIGAIL glances back at STEPHANIE with a fake smile, push-in on STEPHANIE.

canh.loi: He told me he wished I had been the one we lost.
canh.anh: Kitchen at night. ALEXANDER shouts at STEPHANIE, ABIGAIL behind him pretending to cry.
canh.dong: ALEXANDER turns away, STEPHANIE stands frozen, slow pull-back leaving her alone in frame.

canh.loi: Now I'm sick, with little time left. He'll regret every word.
canh.anh: Small plain bedroom, STEPHANIE sits on her bed holding a hospital envelope, rain on the window.
canh.dong: Rain streaks the glass, STEPHANIE closes the envelope, slow push-in on her quiet face.

phim.ten: Runaway Single Mom and Her Billionaire Hubby
phim.nhan_vat: GRACE = young mother late 20s, long dark hair with bangs, cream knit cardigan over white dress (narrator, poster heroine); LILY = her 6-year-old daughter, dark curly hair, school uniform; ETHAN = tall handsome billionaire, dark slicked hair, navy suit; RICH MOM = snobby woman 40s, blonde blowout, designer coat

boi_canh.mo_ta: Rainy bus station at night, factory floor, elite private school entrance, sunlit modern living room

canh.loi: I ran away at midnight with nothing but my daughter.
canh.anh: Rainy bus station at night. GRACE holds LILY close under a thin coat, one small bag at her feet.
canh.dong: A bus pulls in, GRACE lifts LILY and steps aboard, handheld camera follows.

canh.loi: I worked factory shifts so Lily could have a future.
canh.anh: Noisy factory floor, GRACE in an orange safety vest packs boxes, exhausted, a crayon drawing taped to her station.
canh.dong: GRACE glances at the drawing and smiles, keeps working, slow push-in.

canh.loi: My own family sold us out for cash.
canh.anh: Shabby apartment doorway. Relatives hand an envelope of cash to a man in a suit while GRACE watches in shock.
canh.dong: The envelope changes hands, GRACE pulls LILY behind her, fast push-in on her face.

canh.loi: At Lily's elite school, rich moms treated us like trash.
canh.anh: Elite school entrance. A RICH MOM in a designer coat sneers at GRACE's cardigan while other parents whisper.
canh.dong: The rich mom turns her nose up and walks past, LILY squeezes GRACE's hand, slow pan.

canh.loi: Then a billionaire knelt down to help my daughter.
canh.anh: Same school gate. ETHAN in a navy suit kneels to fix LILY's shoe, GRACE looks surprised.
canh.dong: ETHAN ties the lace and smiles up at GRACE, camera rises from LILY to her face.

canh.loi: Everyone who looked down on us is about to learn who he is.
canh.anh: Sunlit modern living room. ETHAN sits with LILY on his lap and GRACE beside him, a family portrait moment.
canh.dong: LILY laughs, ETHAN wraps an arm around GRACE, slow push-in on the three of them.
